description.p: CouchPlay enables local couch co-op on Linux by running multiple gamescope instances simultaneously, and can stream any player to a Moonlight client. Each player gets their own isolated Steam instance with dedicated input devices.

ul.li: Run 2-4 simultaneous gamescope/Steam instances
Automatic input device detection and assignment
Flexible screen layout configuration (split horizontally, vertically, or custom)
Stream any player to a Moonlight client through Sunshine
Per-user Steam configurations and save games
Save and load session profiles for quick setup
Create desktop shortcuts for one-click game launching

description.p: Perfect for couch gaming with friends and family on a single PC with multiple controllers.
Feature release: Moonlight streaming, per-player display placement and controller assignment from player cards. Reinstall the privileged helper after updating: its D-Bus API changed.

ul.li: Stream any player to a Moonlight client through Sunshine, from a virtual display or a monitor
Pair Moonlight clients per gaming user on the Users page, with a stable port per user
Choose each player's display: main screen, a specific monitor or a virtual display
Assign controllers from the player cards with "Press a button…"; Moonlight controllers are assigned to the streaming player automatically
Per-player stream audio sinks, restored reliably around the PipeWire restart
Choose a render resolution and an audio output device per player
Stop the running session cleanly on SIGTERM, SIGINT, SIGHUP or window close
Don't abort launch when the optional Steam shortcut sync can't run for a player who hasn't started Steam
Fix the game selector error in the session setup page, and a first-run window timeout
Grant Flatpak read access to Heroic config and the default game directory
Fix Sunshine port collisions between streaming players
README restructured; internals moved to docs/

description.p: Feature release: profile automation, Steam shortcuts, and session launch fixes

ul.li: Launch saved profiles from the command line (--profile, --start, --exit-after-session)
Add CouchPlay profiles to Steam as Game Mode shortcuts, with Steam source account selection
Unified data-directory model for launcher and game data access; generic application descendants
Fix Steam Big Picture launch (-bigpicture instead of -tenfoot -steamdeck)
Fix Bazzite sessions and simplify player settings
Match session windows by Gamescope process ID
Fix shared-directory selection and host home mapping
Fix per-player directory preparation and profile inheritance
Harden privileged helper path validation and symlink handling

description.p: Feature release: SteamOS support, Flatpak-first install, and cross-distro hardening

ul.li: Flatpak is now the default GUI install (works on every distro); the one-liner installs the Flatpak GUI + helper
SteamOS support: systemd-sysext helper images + Game Mode launcher
Steam Controller support + multi-device controller grouping (DualSense, Steam Controller)
Input-device watching moved into the root helper for reliable device attribution
Non-systemd init support (OpenRC/Artix, runit); the helper D-Bus-activates without a systemd unit
Fix copy-relocation startup failure on Arch/SteamOS (helper libs bundled)
Fix Flatpak /etc isolation; host user/device identity routed through the helper
Fix user creation on Bazzite (missing input group)
Fix PlayStation controller detection + vendor/product parsing
Sunshine-based streaming for split-screen sessions
Controller exit chord (Start+Select) to stop a session
Make PolkitQt6-1 a required CMake dependency to prevent silent build failures
Implement Polkit authorization for CreateUser/DeleteUser
Fix device assignment cache in autoAssignControllers and unassignAll
Fix audio runtime access tracking on TCP listener teardown
Fix borderlessWindows setting persistence and default to true
Fix cross-user audio routing via PipeWire PulseAudio TCP listener
Fix version display in settings (was hardcoded)
Fix missing app icon when installed via one-liner
Remove redundant helper version D-Bus method
Add grid sub-layouts for 3 players
Sequential instance launching for better resource management
Screensaver inhibition during active sessions
Replace machinectl with systemd-run transient units
Improved page navigation and audio routing
Basic session management
Input device detection and assignment
Monitor layout configuration
Profile save/load functionality
